how_to_fill: At a SESSION_DESK or while the loop is held, by the orchestrator, from Mac receipts only (step list: .codex-report/BY-EXT-1.md section 4). Replace each "MAC-PENDING" with the observed value and set each slot's status to "filled" with its receipt path. Never guess a slot. Then run generate_extension.py, then generate_extension.py --tree.

config_model_type.note: config.json model_type (text_config merged). scripts/bytes_manifest.py FAMILIES must contain it, or the headers step refuses and a separately authorized manifest change is needed.

group_size.note: 64 is the mlx-lm convert default and is what the configs carry; verify quantization.group_size and bits=8 in the downloaded config.json (as for Qwen3-8B-8bit). If it differs, fill the observed value and regenerate.

hf_repo.note: Search (2026-10-27) finds the official mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-8bit; RUN_STATE item 66 does not name the organisation. Confirm against ~/night-archive/seats-f18a/models-removed.txt, which holds the revision of the copy deleted on 2026-10-25.

resolvability.note: 3-5 run check that the decode phase is resolvable (block-6 design section 14), as for Qwen3-8B-8bit. Fail drops the model (recorded, no substitute).

clock_hold_ppm.note: H = 5000 / T_stream_max - 0.25 ppm, from this pack's T_stream_max_s.
